title: Railway Journey Song
hook: Passenger path stays separate from railway work.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: warm 3D railway storybook, toy trains, clean platforms and trackside scenes; visual identity: Railway Journey Song

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child following a rail itinerary
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: rail component tied to itinerary or comparison honestly
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Railway Journey Song a door-to-door itinerary: check arrival board, ticket, platform, board passenger car, pass infrastructure, use quiet/sleeper/observation spaces appropriately, then arrive; freight and utility cars remain operational comparisons.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child follows journey stages and knows which cars/services are for passengers versus railway work or freight.
